design: Two independent groups, one feature, 6 by 6 occupied volumes per donor, 50 micrometres pitch, 250 micrometres fine band. Gamma-Poisson counts. Both effect states simulate independent cohorts. Composition setting controls amplitude, and is not the realized explained energy. All rates are per-cohort.
inference: Signed, untruncated nugget-adjusted energy; matching one- and two-step path support. Two-sided absolute difference in equal-patient mean energy. Enumerate up to 512 allocations, otherwise use 511 random allocations and add one. Within each scenario the Monte Carlo allocations are shared, so Wilson intervals condition on that reference. Unrestricted tests at nonzero batch alignment are sensitivity experiments. The intervals exclude uncertainty in model choice.
lookup_rule: Smallest tested n whose lower 95% Wilson sensitivity bound reaches 0.8 and upper null-rejection bound is at most 0.1. Complete aliasing excluded. Null means no tested n qualifies. Interpolation in the figure is visual.
